stem: The value of a painting increased by the same percent each year from 2019 to 2021. The painting was worth 8,000 dollars in 2019 and 9,680 dollars in 2021. By what percent did the value of the painting increase each year?
solution: Let \(r\) be the yearly growth factor. Then \(8{,}000r^{2} = 9{,}680\), so \(r^{2} = 1.21\).
A growth factor of 1.1 is an increase of \(10\%\) per year.
verify:
r = symbols('r', positive=True)
s = solve(Eq(8000*r**2, 9680), r)
assert s == [Rational(11, 10)]
assert Rational(spr_answers[0]) == (s[0] - 1)*100
